page.overview:
Who is Harriet McDougal?

Harriet Rigney is Robert Jordan's widow and sometime editor. Much of his characterization of female inhabitants of the Westlands comes directly from his views about his wife.

After her husband's death she oversaw, along with the author Brandon Sanderson, the completion and publication of the final entries in the Wheel of Time series: The Gathering Storm, Towers of Midnight, and A Memory of Light. She also worked extensively on the The Wheel of Time Companion based on The Wheel of Time series.

Harriet provided a reading of the "Wind" sequence from A Memory of Light at the Charleston book signing event on 01/12/2013.

Harriet is a consultant producer for The Wheel of Time television series.
